name: tri_modal_embedder
summary: Every record crystallizes across three adjacent domains: VECTOR (BLAKE3 hex), WAVE (DCT-II spectrum of content-as-audio, L2-normalized), TIME (forward + inverted sinusoidal positional encoding with self-healing residual signature). The crystal links all three. Lookup in any one domain returns the other two — the adjacent possible cache. Inverted-time arm provides differential-amplifier tamper detection.
engine_pattern: pure Python — no numpy/scipy. BLAKE3 (or blake2b fallback). DCT-II implemented from math.cos basis. Positional encoding from math.sin/cos with geometric frequencies (transformer-style).

vector.retrieval: exact match or n-gram overlap (via moe_router)

wave.method: DCT-II of UTF-8 bytes treated as audio samples in [-1, 1]

time.self_healing: forward + inverted produces (0, 2cos, 0, 2cos, ...) residual signature — differential-amplifier; tampering breaks the pattern instantly

inbound_callers: (planned) inference_logger.log — add tri_modal_crystal to each InferenceRecord
(planned) workflow_generator — every emitted file gets a tri-modal seal in its header
outbound_calls: blake3 (or blake2b fallback) — content + crystal hashing
math.sin / math.cos — DCT basis + positional encoding

self_healing_check.principle: differential amplifier — forward + inverted should produce known fixed signature
self_healing_check.expected_residual: (0, 2*cos, 0, 2*cos, ...) — sin pairs cancel, cos pairs double
self_healing_check.tamper_detection: any byte flip in forward or inverted arm breaks the pattern → reject

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.compare_unrelated_strings: wave_cosine=0.529 (weaker but non-zero — DCT of bytes is content-order sensitive)
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.determinism: same content + same timestamp + same btc_height → same crystal, byte-for-byte

guarantees: Deterministic — same (content, timestamp, btc_height) → same TriModalCrystal, every time
Tamper-evident time arm — flipping any byte in forward OR inverted breaks residual signature
L2-normalized wave — cosine similarity is dot product (cheap, comparable)
Pure Python — no numpy/scipy dependencies — works on any Python 3 environment
performance_notes: DCT-II is O(n * k) where n = SAMPLE_CAP (2048 bytes) and k = WAVE_COEFFS (64). Pure-Python ~10ms per crystallize.
Future: pyfftw or numpy fallback when available → ~50× faster.
Time encoding is O(dim) — negligible (~16 sin/cos calls).
usage_example: from tri_modal_embedder import TriModalCrystal\ntmc = TriModalCrystal.of('hello world', btc_height=945000)\nprint(tmc.crystal[:16], tmc.verify())
